title: Audit Configuration Changes in Settings
description: Complete the audit configuration changes workflow in the Settings module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with admin access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Settings module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for audit configuration changes are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the Settings module from the main navigation.
Locate the audit configuration changes entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for audit configuration changes.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Audit Configuration Changes completes without warnings or blockers.
Resulting records are visible in the expected Settings views.
Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during audit configuration changes.
Permission constraints prevent completion of audit configuration changes.
Output is created but not linked to the expected workflow context.
recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun audit configuration changes.
Confirm role permissions for admin and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun audit configuration changes?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm audit configuration changes is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
